response.changelog:
Pixel OS v2.1.4-b1 — Opt-In iOS Style UI Beta on Android 17 for Realme X2 Pro (RMX1931)
• Dual EXT4 + F2FS /data Support & Installer Guards: upgrades /vendor/etc/fstab.qcom to mount both EXT4 and F2FS /data partitions natively on Linux 4.14.356 and adds pre-flight OTA install safety checks
• 1:1 Apple iOS 26 Phone, Keypad & Live Call Screen (IosDialer v1.7.6-ios26): clean-room 90Hz Liquid Glass Phone + Telecom InCallService in /system/priv-app with Hooke-spring sliding 5-tab Liquid Glass capsule, circular iOS 26 Keypad, and live wallpaper-blurred Call Screen (zero third-party iCall 26 ads/bloat)
• Polished iOS 26 Messages (IosMessages v1.7.5-ios26): /system/priv-app with RoleManager SMS verification, single docked Liquid Glass Search + Compose bar, and live Audio Call header action
• Fixed Home Screen Left/Right Swipe Cross-Flash & Top Status/Notification Bar Pull-Down + Smooth 90Hz Lock Screen Pull-Up
• Compact Wireless Patch OTA (< 80 MiB — no 1.81 GB full system re-download required!) + Chrome/Brave Native Renderer Fix & 4K60 Gyro-EIS3
